finalMessage:
./<package>/XTest.kt`, JUnit4 with `assertEquals`, names in camelCase sentences, resources in `strings.xml`.

| rule | deviation | count | examples | introduced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Test names: one convention (`fun does_thing()` or backticks or plain camelCase) | Three styles mixed: `testNegativeControl_x_mustY`, `ageBadge_andDeliveryTone_pairs...`, short `noExisting_nullDraft` | ~339 tests, 3 styles | `NegativeControl...Test.kt:33`, `ThemeContrastTest.kt:96`, `IntakeDatingRuleTest.kt:23` | ThemeContrast: R1/R2 model; Negative: earlier "MACA v2" commit; not blamed |
| One test class name per class under test | Duplicate class names in different packages | 1 pair | `report/PatientPrintHtmlGeneratorTest.kt:9`, `ui/report/PatientPrintHtmlGeneratorTest.kt` | not blamed |
| Test file placement matches the package of the code under test | Root-level test file; `ui/ClinicalFormatR2Test`, `ClinicalFormatTest`, `DeliveryNotesParserTest` + `ParseDeliveryNotesSpecTest` split by round, not by subject | 5 | `NegativeControl...Test.kt`, `ClinicalFormatR2Test.kt`, `DeliveryNotesParserTest.kt` | round-based naming (R1/R2) |
| Use constants, not repeated string keys | Literal key next to an existing const | 2 | `SecuritySettingsRepository.kt:~88` vs `KEY_PIN_CHANGE_REQUIRED` | R3c code written to satisfy S14 |
| Remove dead code and unused API | `NEVER` check, unused `shouldLockOnBackground`, `AutoLockTimeout` 5 values | 3+ | `SecuritySettingsRepository.kt:52,15,~165` | R3c |
| Strings in resources | Hard-coded English in enum labels, Arabic names equal English | 11 values | `SecuritySettingsRepository.kt:10-23` | before R3 |
| Imports sorted alphabetically | `android.util.Base64` after kotlinx, `java.security` after; `import java.time.LocalDate` last vs first in other files | ~4 files | `SecuritySettingsRepository.kt:3-8`, `NegativeControl...Test.kt:21` | not blamed |
| Comment style/density | Banner comments `// ====` and long KDoc in tests vs none in others | 4 | `NegativeControl...Test.kt:27-35`, `BackupVault...Test.kt` | MACA v2 commit |
| Magic numbers named | 600_000, 120_000, 280, 320 repeated | 6+ | `PinPolicy.kt:8`, `GestationalAgeEngine.kt:77`, `IntakeDatingRule.kt:25` | mixed |
| Python checks share helpers | `strip_comments`, `block_after`, `read`, `record` copied into 4 scripts, with divergent versions (bug #4) | 4 files | `check_r3.py:36`, `check_r3b.py:34`, `check_r3c.py:37`, `check_r3d.py:36` | R3 rounds |

I did not run `git blame`, so the "introduced by" column is from commit subjects only and may be wrong.

### Not covered / not verified
- Not run: no tests, no Python checks, no Gradle.
- I did not read the larger test files in full (`ParseDeliveryNotesSpecTest` 757 lines, `AncStateTest`, `ClinicalCommandsTest`, `EncryptedBackupTest`, `RecordAnomaliesTest`, `ClinicalCodexRepositoryTest`). I only counted `@Test`s and grepped for trivial assertions (none found beyond those listed).
- `check_ui_static_r2.py` was read only at the top (masking technique described in its docstring looks sound).
- Bug #3 (agreedEdd overwrite) and #7 (weak PIN after restart) are code reads, not run. Spec ids in the manifest (`P1`...`U7`) were not verified against `SPEC_FIX*.md`.

### Verdict: YES-after-fixes
Three things to fix first:
1. Make `androidTest` compile (bug #1: 11 calls to `seedInitialSyntheticFixtures()`) and add `compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin` to the manifest gate. Today the vault, encryption and security device tests are unrunnable and nobody is told.
2. Replace static-regex "proofs" of safety behaviour with unit tests on fakes: PIN and lockout (`SecuritySettingsRepository`), the cleanup and orphan-delete guard (`VaultFiles`/`VaultController`), and `seed(includeDemoPatients=false)`. These guard the real clinic data.
3. Fix the tests that pass for the wrong reason: the Rh tautology (#2), the backup test that compares fixtures with themselves (#9), and the intake-dating helper that can never express a clinician-agreed EDD (#3).
